uk CSHM-6 Belfast - May 2016 Introduction Renewable and clean energy has gained significant attentions in recent research due to greenhouse effects by traditional energy sources
In wind turbine system, the most critical component is wind turbine blade and the manufacturing cost of composite blade is about 15–20% of wind turbine production cost [1]
Fatigue is one of the most critical mechanical damage in layered composite blades during the designed lifetime of usually 25-30 years for offshore wind turbines [3]

Considering the nature of cumulative fatigue process of fatigue damage, the gamma process model is an appropriate approach for performance deterioration since gamma process is proved to be more versatile and increasingly used in optimal maintenance strategies [4]
The gamma process can predict the fatigue damage evolution accurately and estimate the remain used service time to reach any critical damage [5]
